title: IM60037: Management And Productivity
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic concepts of management, Evolution of management thought, Management
factors: Planning, Organizing, Leadership, Motivation and Control. Organization
and management of business and industry in India: Evolution, long and short
term perspective for growth, Diversification in the context of changing
environment: Social, economic, technological, etc. Productivity; Definitions,
Scope and measurement, Productivity improvement methods for organizations in
India.
Books
•Production Systems, Planning Analysis and Control, James L. Riggs, John Wiley
•Essentials of Management, Koontz and O’Donnel, Mcgraw-Hill
•Operations Management, Kostas, N. Dervitsiotis
•Modern Production Management, Elwood S. Buffa, Wiley Eastern
